children: Median expectations for price growth over the next 12 months in the Euro Area increased to 3% in August 2026 from 2.9%.
Expectations for inflation three years ahead also increased, to 2.9% from 2.7%, while the five-year outlook went up to 2.5% from 2.4%.

Uncertainty about expectations for inflation over the next 12 months decreased, but remained higher than the level prevailing before the start of the conflict in the Middle East. Lower-income households continued to perceive and anticipate higher inflation than higher-income groups, while younger consumers maintained more moderate expectations than older respondents.
Also, expectations for nominal income growth were unchanged at 1%.
Those for economic growth remained at -1.2% while expectations for the unemployment rate 12 months ahead decreased to 11% from 11.2%.
In addition, consumers expected the price of their home to increase by 3.4% over the next 12 months and mortgage interest rates to increase 4.9%, the same as in July.

title: Euro Area Consumer Inflation Expectations Edge Up
